expectations.text: Contains at least one H2 header phrased as a question

expectations.text: Uses short paragraphs, not uniform blocks
expectations.evidence: Multiple one-line paragraphs: "Yeah. Even those." / "Months. One day."

expectations.text: Ending callbacks to a concrete image already used earlier

"Cold turkey. Not a minimalist phase, not a budget thing. Scar tissue." and "Months. One day."
